versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: tanks. In the case of gravity feed systems with tanks whose outlets are interconnected, it shall not be possible for fuel to flow between tanks in quantities sufficient to cause an overflow of fuel from the tank vent when the airplane is operated as specified in § 3.437 (a) and the tanks are full.
